title: Chapter 251 Military Parade
content:
Chapter 251 Military Parade

As soon as Wang Shuo finished speaking, a lord worriedly said: "Lord Wang, our territory is weak and I am afraid we are not qualified to confront Nanshan Group head-on!"

Wang Shuo saw that someone else wanted to speak, so he immediately interrupted and said: "Don't worry, everyone, you only need to support this operation, I will take on the task of confronting head-on."

In this way, other lords can no longer find excuses to shirk.

If you are not willing to support such a small thing, then why set up Nanshan Group? Just stay in the territory and wait for death.

Afterwards, Wang Shuo told everyone his plan, and everyone looked at each other in surprise.

"As long as everyone is willing to send troops and jointly besiege Nanshan Group, you can go to Wana Village to buy various supplies."

Wang Shuo handed the list he had prepared to the lords.

Many of these lords do not have a complete industrial system. Some are rich in iron ore resources, and some are rich in grain. Wang Shuo's move also intends to build Wana Village into a trade center.

The supplies provided by Wang Shuo also include supplies such as war horses, which made many lords very envious.

In addition, there are a large number of sophisticated equipment and qualifications to enter the dungeon.

Under various preferential policies, many lords have been tempted.

Wang Shuo's request is just to send his elite troops to besiege from the side when Wang Shuo and Nanshanji's army are fighting, so that Nanshanji has to divide a part of the army to deal with them.

Of course, if you want to obtain the most core resources such as war horses and weapons, you have to send a part of the army under Wang Shuo's command to participate in the main attack.

Wang Shuo left a day for everyone to consider.

After the meeting, Wang Shuo held a grand military parade.

Let the lords see the military strength of Wana Village.

Wang Shuo took everyone to the resource exchange office first and let everyone see the materials that can be exchanged.

After a long period of exchange, the resource exchange stone was finally upgraded to level 2.

The materials that can be exchanged have increased a lot.

Including horse cards, life potions, mental potions, and even food and various sophisticated equipment.

It's just that the quantity of each material is not unlimited, and the price is expensive.

The most useful things here for Wang Shuo are only tools. Wang Shuo doesn't care about other resources, but for other lords, they are real good things.

For example, food. If your territory is short of food, it's good to get food. How can you complain about it being expensive?

In special times, the price increases by more than ten or twenty times. It's common. Wang Shuo once had the honor to buy Shanghai green (green vegetables) for 50 yuan per catty.

After opening the eyes of the lords, Wang Shuo asked everyone to stand on the platform.

Ayub led the Red Flame Army and passed through the central square one by one.

Neat military appearance, uniform equipment, and more importantly, level.

After more than a week of training, the level of the Red Flame Army has generally increased to about level 30.

Seeing this result, Wang Shuo was also a little surprised, because he was only about level 31.

Since the destruction of Pegasus Village, Wang Shuo has not leveled up, and even many of his generals have surpassed him.

During this period, Wang Shuo has been making dead spirit beads and practicing internal strength.

Internal strength can enhance combat power more than level, so it is worth it.

Without the Black Dragon Sutra, Wang Shuo would never have been able to defeat Gude.

At this time, Wang Shuo noticed that the levels of the lords on the stage were all around level 30.

The highest one was the Xinxiang Village Lord Xu Pingwei, who was already level 34, which shocked Wang Shuo.

Compared with Wang Shuo's shock, the other lords could not be described as shocked. They were in a state of turmoil at the moment.

The entire army of nearly 4,000 people was all around level 30. This force was simply a bit despairing.
